entities.summary: Jose Alan Verdejo Dialogo is a Filipino bishop of the Roman Catholic Church who currently serves as the Bishop of the Diocese of Sorsogon in the Philippines. He was appointed to this position by Pope Francis on October 15, 2019, and was consecrated on December 12, 2019. He officially assumed office on December 14, 2019.
